name: manga-translator
description: Manga Translator - extensão Chromium para tradução automática de mangás e quadrinhos usando Google Gemini

scripts.setup: npm --prefix tests ci && npm --prefix tests run test:e2e:setup
scripts.test:all: npm run test:smoke && npm run test:ci && npm run test:visual && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix tests run test:coverage && npm --prefix tests run test:coverage:verify
